guidance: Boundary behavior changed (>= -> >); the exact boundary value may now be accepted, rejected, included, or omitted differently.
Assert the exact changed boundary through a public or exported behavior, then check the returned value, thrown error, side effect, or serialized artifact.

The obvious assertion path may still pass if a later guard, fallback, normalization, or serialization step collapses original and mutated values. Prefer a call path where the mutated value changes returned output, thrown error, side effect, or persisted artifact.
Combined-condition behavior changed (&& -> ||); an input satisfying only one side of the condition may now take the opposite branch.
Assert the mixed-input case where only one side of the condition is true, using an observable public behavior rather than the internal condition alone.
